propertySets.name: Pset_JunctionBoxTypeData
propertySets.definition: The property set can be used by the predefined type DATA of IfcJunctionBox.

properties.name: DataConnectionType
properties.definition: Indicates the data connection type of the junction box e.g. copper pair, fiber or others.

propertySets.name: Pset_OpticalSplitter
propertySets.definition: Properties of optical splitter used in the telecommunication domain. This property set can be used by the predefined type DATA of IfcJunctionBox.

properties.name: NumberOfBranches
properties.definition: Indicates the number of branches that can be supported by the optical splitter.

properties.name: OpticalSplitterType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of optical splitter, single mode or multi-mode.

properties.name: NumberOfInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the types of interfaces and their number in the device.
